description: Vercel env var contract for the two in-scope Vercel frontends (task 5cb4a8fe slice 5, AC3 Vercel half). Each VITE_* value is derived from infra/cloud/hostname-matrix.json; tests/cloud/scripts/check-vercel-env-matrix.mjs asserts that on every CI run. Quinn provisions the actual values in the Vercel dashboard per the contract; this file records the contract, not the values. Do not edit a value here without updating the corresponding Vercel environment, and vice versa — the static check exits 1 on drift between the contract and the matrix.

outOfScope.reason: GymTrack production hostname scope deferred per tech design OQ5; the Clerk cutover (task bb09eaed) owns any GymTrack matrix changes. The GymTrack Vercel env vars (VITE_SUPABASE_URL, VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, VITE_GYMTRACK_MCP_BASE_URL, VITE_AUTH_PROVIDER) are out of scope for this slice.

Root /website Vercel project is static marketing content with no API surface; no VITE_* env vars are in scope. Tracking under sindustries.co.nz apex (production) and a future website.staging.sindustries.co.nz (preview) is a separate task; the matrix row exists in name only via the apex domain convention.
